```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(tidymodels)
library(gbm)
library(e1071)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(pdp)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(corrplot)
```
# Load the data
```{r}
load("severity.RData")
dat <- na.omit(dat)
set.seed(4027)
my_dat <- dat[sample(nrow(dat), 1000), ]
```

# Convert Variables
```{r}
my_dat <- my_dat %>%
  mutate(
    severity = factor(severity,
                      levels = c(0,1),
                      labels = c("NotSevere","Severe")),

    gender = factor(gender,
                    levels = c(0,1),
                    labels = c("Female","Male")),

    hypertension = factor(hypertension),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes),
    vaccine = factor(vaccine),

    race = factor(race,
                  levels = c(1,2,3,4),
                  labels = c("White","Asian","Black","Hispanic")),

    smoking = factor(smoking,
                     levels = c(0,1,2),
                     labels = c("Never","Former","Current"))
  )
```

# Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(1234)
split <- initial_split(my_dat,
                       prop = 0.8,
                       strata = severity)

train_dat <- training(split)
test_dat  <- testing(split)
```

# Exploratory Analysis
```{r}
# Summary table
summary_table <- train_dat %>%
  select(-id) %>%
  summary()
knitr::kable(summary_table)
```

```{r}
# Continuous variable
p1 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = age,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    alpha = 0.6,
    position = "identity"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Age Distribution")

p2 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = height,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Height by Severity")

p3 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = weight,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Weight by Severity")

p4 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = bmi,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("BMI by Severity")

p5 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = SBP,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("SBP by Severity")

p6 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = LDL,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("LDL by Severity")

p7 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = severity,
                 y = depression,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Depression by Severity")

((p1 + p2 + p3) /
 (p4 + p5 + p6) /
 (p7)) +
plot_layout(guides = "collect",
            heights = c(1,1,1.6)) &
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
)

```
```{r}
# Categorical variables
c1 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = gender,

c2 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = race,
                 fill = severity)) +

  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Race vs Severity")

c3 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = smoking,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Smoking vs Severity")

c4 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = hypertension,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Hypertension vs Severity")

c5 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = diabetes,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Diabetes vs Severity")

c6 <- ggplot(my_dat,
             aes(x = vaccine,
                 fill = severity)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Vaccination vs Severity")

(c1 + c2 + c3) /
(c4 + c5 + c6)
```
```{r}
# Correlations
continuous_vars <- my_dat %>%
  select(
    age,
    height,
    weight,
    bmi,
    SBP,
    LDL,
    depression
  )

cor_matrix <- cor(continuous_vars)

corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.7
)
```
